prompt.content: Who was the American ice hockey player that signed an exclusive licensing agreement with Accolade alongside Pelé?

output:
The American ice hockey player who signed an exclusive licensing agreement with Accolade (now Activision Blizzard) alongside Pelé was **Wayne Gretzky**.

Wayne Gretzky, the legendary Canadian hockey player, was one of the most prominent figures to sign such an agreement with Activision
